pairs.question_text: Describe how your organisation complies with DCB0129 and how the clinical safety case for the proposed solution is maintained.
Provide the name and qualifications of your Clinical Safety Officer and describe their role in the delivery of this contract.
Confirm your organisation's current Data Security and Protection Toolkit status and describe how compliance is maintained.
Provide details of your Data Protection Officer and describe your information governance arrangements.
Confirm whether your organisation holds ISO/IEC 27001 certification and provide the certificate number, scope and date of issue.
Confirm whether you hold Cyber Essentials Plus certification and provide the certificate number and expiry date.
Describe how user access to the solution is controlled, including authentication, role-based access and audit of access to patient records.
Describe the interoperability standards the solution supports and its integration with NHS national services.
Describe how the solution will integrate with the Trust's electronic patient record and patient administration system, including your approach to integration testing.
Provide an outline implementation plan showing the key phases, milestones and timescales from contract award to go-live.
Describe your support arrangements and service levels, including service desk hours, incident priority definitions and response and resolution targets.
Describe your commercial model, including how charges are structured, the proposed contract term and any dependencies on user or bed numbers. Do not include prices in this response.
Describe your commitment to achieving net zero and provide details of your Carbon Reduction Plan.
Provide an overview of your organisation, including its legal status, size and relevant experience of delivering similar solutions to NHS organisations.

expected.buyer: Harbourside University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust

pairs.question_text: Please describe your compliance with the DCB0129 clinical risk management standard, including the clinical safety case for the product offered.
Explain your hazard log process and how clinical safety incidents are reported, investigated and resolved.
Please state your latest Data Security and Protection Toolkit assessment outcome and explain how you keep it current.
How will you help us complete our Data Protection Impact Assessment, and what controller and processor roles apply to the proposed service?
State the location of hosting and processing for all personal data and confirm whether any transfer outside the United Kingdom occurs.
Do you hold ISO 27001 certification? Provide the certificate number, the certifying body, the scope and the date of issue.
How often is the solution penetration tested, by whom, and how quickly are vulnerabilities remediated?
Which open standards does the solution support, and how does it connect to national NHS services such as the Personal Demographics Service?
How does the solution use SNOMED CT, dm+d and the NHS number to record and exchange clinical information?
How will the implementation be governed, and how will risks and issues be managed and escalated?
How will you train our staff before go-live, and what training is available afterwards for new starters?
What exit management support do you provide, and how will data be returned or transferred to a successor supplier?
Set out your organisation's net zero commitment and summarise your published Carbon Reduction Plan.
What commitments do you make to local employment, apprenticeships and skills development as part of this contract?

expected.buyer: Northern Fells Community Health NHS Trust
